parts.name: Door
parts.Basic_description: This is the door of the safe, made of steel, forming the front panel that opens and closes to access the interior.
parts.Functional_description: It provides secure closure and protection for the contents inside the safe, typically locked by a mechanism connected to the switch.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a hinge axis to open or close the safe.

parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the switch or knob of the safe, made of steel, located on the door surface.
parts.Functional_description: It is used to operate the locking mechanism, allowing the user to lock or unlock the door.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates or turns to engage or disengage the locking mechanism.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the safe, made of steel, forming the structural enclosure that houses the door and internal space.
parts.Functional_description: It provides the main structural integrity and protection for the contents, resisting external force or tampering.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during normal operation.
